description: Conditionally loaded reference node graph. The entry risk judgment selects the lane: every risk takes the common entry and mandatory-verification stack; low-fast-path is retained only as a legacy compatibility record. When a node when is satisfied, load its full path together with its requires edges, and do not load unrelated nodes. Each node's when is the canonical load condition. SKILL.md restates them as prose on purpose, because the agent reads SKILL.md at runtime and may never open this file — the copy is a projection, not a duplicate to delete, and skill-contract.test.mjs fails when a loader:agent node is missing from that section.

bundleContract.purpose: Deterministic pre-joined reads of the same reference bytes. A bundle exists to stabilize the prompt prefix so a repeat session hits the cache, and never to summarize or replace node content.
rules: A bundle is optional. Reading its nodes individually is always valid and produces the same bytes.
Report the node ids in the lane header, never the bundle id.
Never hand-edit bundles/ — edit the reference node and regenerate.
A bundle contains every requires edge of its declared nodes, in dependency-first order.

A continuation bundle (`after`) delivers only the nodes its base bundles did not; the header lists the assumed nodes. Read it only when the base bundle's nodes are already in context — reading base + continuation equals reading the full lane node set once.
delivery-lane is entry-only. Later phase reads come from oracle-run status; resolve their reference-graph dependencies, reading only missing applicable nodes.
